The '''search for Tulak Hord's artifacts''' was a search in [[3643 BBY]] for five artifacts that the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]] once possessed. [[Darth Zash]] wanted to acquire these artifacts to aid her in an ancient ritual that could [[Essence transfer|transfer her consciousness]] into a new host because she became decrepit due to her continued research into [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|the dark side]]. Zash decided to have her [[Darth Nox|new apprentice]] locate the artifacts for her while she remained on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to oversee preparations for the ritual with her new apprentices, [[Corrin (Sith Empire)|Corrin]] and [[Kaal]].<ref name="Old" />

Her apprentice located each artifact on different planets before the Inquisitor returned to Dromund Kaas to report to their master. But Zash had lied to them about the ritual: she wished to cheat death and used her student as a means to an end, since she hoped to inhabit them. However, their confrontation saw her apprentice's [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Khem Val]] intervene to save the Inquisitor. It resulted in Zash's consciousness transferring into Val instead; but Val being [[Force-bond/Legends|bound]] to the Inquisitor meant that Zash was forced to serve her apprentice with her plans to cheat death failing spectacularly.<ref name="TOR:Legacy" />

==Prelude==
{{Main|Mission to Naga Sadow's tomb|Duel in the Sith Academy}}
{{Quote|Your work so far – in bringing back this holocron and now the text from Tulak Hord's tomb – has me intrigued. I am watching your progress eagerly. I have high hopes for you, acolyte. Sky high|Darth Zash commends Kallig|<ref name="Old" />}}
[[File:Opening_the_door.png|thumb|left|220px|Kallig releases Khem Val from stasis in Naga Sadow's tomb.]]
The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zash|Zash]] in her career delved into ancient rituals related to [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|the dark side]]. Zash was an academic and was enthusiastic to seek out ancient knowledge and power that could further her ambitions. But this research into the dark side took an extreme toll on her since it started to deform her physical form. To that end, she maintained a [[Mind trick/Legends|Force illusion]] to hide her appearance as she searched for a cure to restore herself to a more appropriate and youthful visage.<ref name="Old" />

Zash's studies led her to believe that an [[essence transfer]] ritual could be used to save her and she had to locate artifacts related to the ancient Sith Lord [[Tulak Hord]] since the ritual was related to him. This would enable her to transfer her consciousness into a younger host body and could ensure that she could cheat death. But Zash needed to collect several artifacts related to Hord and needed to select an able-bodied apprentice - or more accurately, a pawn - to take her spirit when the artifacts were collected. Zash also had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] in which she saw her apprentice overcome [[Aloysius Kallig|the raging spirit]] that dwelt in the [[Dark Temple]] and that the student would therefore be granted Hord's knowledge and could in turn become her vessel.<ref name="Old" />

To find an apprentice was crucial to Zash: she tasked the [[overseer]] [[Harkun]] to get prospective new students to acquire artifacts related to Hord. Zash was unable to do this herself since her superior [[Darth Skotia]] would become suspicious of her intentions. To that end, she also began to set in motion plans to kill Skotia so that she could ascend to his position and continue her search for artifacts with little concern of interference. But Zash did at one point fail to retrieve [[Tulak Hord's holocron (Tomb of Marka Ragnos)|Hord's holocron]] from [[Tomb of Marka Ragnos|the tomb]] of the ancient Sith Lord [[Marka Ragnos]] and was denied access to the innermost chamber in the Dark Temple on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] because Skotia refused to grant her access in full awareness of her ambitions and devious nature, sentiments that his superior [[Darth Thanaton]] also harbored.<ref name="Old" />
{{Quote|Your final trial will be to retrieve an ancient map from the innermost chamber of Naga Sadow's tomb which has never been breached in thousands of years|Harkun explains the trial to Kallig|<ref name="Old" />}}
Zash monitored the progress of [[Darth Nox|one particular student]] (a former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]) and became impressed when they [[Mission to Naga Sadow's tomb|managed to retrieve]] Hord's holocron and also an important map from the [[tomb of Naga Sadow]] (as well as Hord's former [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] servant [[Khem Val]]). The Sith Lord took this student as her apprentice and the two proceeded to Dromund Kaas for the next stage of her plan; it was there that she informed her apprentice about the ritual, but lied about its true nature.<ref name="Old" />

==The hunt==
===Dromund Kaas===
{{Main|Mission to Darth Skotia's bunker|Mission to Lord Grathan's estate|Duel in the Sith Sanctum}}
[[File:Skotia_death.png|thumb|right|220px|Kallig defeats Darth Skotia.]]
The first matter to attend to was to eliminate Darth Skotia in order to provide both master and apprentice the full freedom needed to conduct their search without interference or suspicion. Zash planned Skotia's death and tasked her apprentice [[Mission to Lord Grathan's estate|to acquire]] a [[Cyber neutralizer|device]] to incapacitate Skotia and a [[Trandoshan relic|Trandoshan tablet]] that would ensure that Skotia's Trandoshan bodyguards would aid in killing Skotia. The Inquisitor acquired both and was sent [[Duel in the Sith Sanctum|to confront]] Skotia in [[Darth Skotia's bunker|his bunker]]; the student slew the Sith Lord after the latter killed the Trandoshan guards when the tablet was used against them.<ref name="Old" />

Skotia's death saw Zash made a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] and titled as a [[Darth/Legends|Darth]]. The next plan put into motion was to determine if the apprentice was the one Zash saw in her vision. Her student managed to overcome the raging spirit, which was revealed to be the Inquisitor's ancestor, Aloysius Kallig, who had served Tulak Hord before the latter killed him. Aloysius warned the apprentice to be wary of their master, Khem Val and any future apprentices, and believed they would bear his name and restore it to greatness. Zash was astounded when this was revealed to her since it also confirmed her vision that her new apprentice was the one to take part in her ritual. Her apprentice, now bearing the Kallig name, also gave her the first artifact in their hunt which was recovered from the Dark Temple after the Inquisitor confronted their ancestor's spirit.<ref name="Old" />

===Balmorra===
[[File:Hazard_Vault_305.png|thumb|left|220px|Hazard Vault 305 on Balmorra.]]
Apprentice Kallig's first mission was to [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] to acquire the second artifact sealed in [[Hazard Vault 305]]; their master directed them to contact [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bessiker]] to aid them in their search for it. Bessiker said that the vault was converted into a toxic waste storage site that [[Colicoid/Legends|colicoids]] had overrun and that a serum could be created to make them immune to the waste. However, [[Iannos Tyrek]], who had recently defected, was the only one capable enough to be able to produce it. Tyrek was captured but Bessiker was reluctant to continue to provide help to Kallig unless the latter helped liberate his son, [[Hiran Bessiker|Hiran]], from a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] prison cell. The apprentice stormed the prison on the [[Gorinth Plateau]] in search of the major's son. They found and conversed with him but ultimately killed Hiran, which was witnessed by an agent sent by Bessiker.<ref name="Old" />

The furious Bessiker attacked the Inquisitor but was slain in the encounter. This left Kallig free to receive the serum from Tyrek, whom they executed, and used it to move through the waste to retrieve the artifact.<ref name="Old" />

===Nar Shaddaa===
The third artifact was located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], in the possession of the Sith Lord [[Paladius]], who ran the [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]]. Kallig arrived planetside and met with the former cultists [[Destris Veran]] and [[Rylee Dray]]; Kallig managed to secure their assistance when promising them that the pair would inherit control of the cult when Paladius was dealt with. But it was soon determined that Paladius needed to be weakened in order to be defeated. The first thing to do was for Kallig to build their reputation, doing so after killing the leaders of the infamous Krayt Gang.<ref name="Old" />

The next move was to demonstrate Kallig's powers to Paladius' followers as being superior, to ensure that some would desert the Sith Lord. To do this meant to produce a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] beneath the ground via a controlled explosion to make it seem as if Kallig could manipulate the environment around them. Kallig obtained a detonator from [[Gord Madel]] and then showed up in the [[Meridian Hall]] where Paladius gave an address via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. Paladius attempted to smear Kallig as a fraud whose powers were insignificant despite the fact that the apprentice was able to demonstrate their abilities through the explosion.<ref name="Old" />

Paladius contacted Kallig soon after and offered them the artifact in exchange for leaving him alone, so that he could lead his cult in peace. Veran and Dray accompanied Kallig to meet with Paladius; the elder Sith tried to double-cross Kallig but was defeated in the ensuing confrontation. Paladius immediately offered his complete loyalty to Kallig in exchange for being spared. Veran and Dray protested, but the apprentice ultimately chose to betray them and killed Veran by throwing him off the main platform. Paladius then assured Dray that she would survive, but be punished. Dray attempted to flee, but Paladius killed her with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Kallig then left Paladius in charge of the cult in their name.<ref name="Old" />

===Tatooine===
The fourth artifact was on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and in the hands of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who settled on that world. Zash instructed Kallig to locate the pirate [[Andronikos Revel]] but learnt from his former girlfriend [[Casey Rix]] that Revel's [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] [[Sylas Wilkes]] mutinied and stole Revel's blasters and the artifact. Rix helped Kallig locate Revel, who decided to aid the apprentice in order to get revenge against Wilkes and recover his lost blasters. It was during their search that the two learnt that Wilkes was mutinied against in turn after he ousted Revel and that the crew stole the artifact and blasters before retreating deep into the harsh desert environment.<ref name="Old" />

Kallig and Revel followed the trail into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] and found logs indicating that the artifact made the pirates go insane over time. The pair found and recovered the artifact off a dead pirate and returned to Kallig's ship before Revel announced his intention to leave Tatooine and join Kallig's crew.<ref name="Old" />

===Alderaan===
The fifth and final artifact was revealed to be on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], in the possession of [[House of Organa|House Organa]]. Zash put Kallig in contact with [[Elana Thul]] of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] (a vital Imperial contact) and learnt that the artifact in question was located in the [[Elysium]] Vaults. The drawback was that the key to enter was in the possession of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomar Organa]]. Kallig was therefore forced to break into the library of [[House Alde]] and look through the records for information that could assist their investigation. In them Kallig learnt that [[Rehanna Rist|Rehanna]] of [[House Rist]] was once engaged to Organa who cancelled their [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] so that he could become a Jedi.<ref name="Old" />

This revelation prompted Kallig to visit Rist and the apprentice managed to manipulate her to contact Organa and lure him to Alderaan so that they could kill him. Organa sensed the deception but was slain in the confrontation with Kallig. This enabled for Kallig to enter the vaults and recover the artifact in question.<ref name="Old" />

===Kallig's warnings===
{{Quote|Her words smell of honey and taste of poison|Aloysius Kallig warns his heir about Zash's ambitions|<ref name="Old" />}}
Kallig's ancestor, meanwhile, visited them several times during his travels to different planets in order to warn them about Zash's activities on Dromund Kaas. He told his heir not to trust Zash and that she had taken two new apprentices, [[Corrin (Sith Empire)|Corrin]] and [[Kaal]], to aid her in preparing her ritual in the Dark Temple. He believed she would cause his heir harm and advised the young Kallig to prepare for betrayal and for a manner to deal with Zash when the inevitable came.<ref name="Old" />

===Ritual in the Dark Temple===
{{Main|Duel in the Dark Temple}}
{{Quote|Listen, apprentice: various Force rituals have helped me maintain my appearance and some of my vitality. But inevitably, life fades. I'm dying, apprentice. My will, my intellect, my spirit are as lively as ever, but this body is dying|Darth Zash explains her predicament to Kallig.|<ref name="TOR:Legacy" />}}
[[File:Old_Zash.png|thumb|right|220px|Zash reveals her true form to Kallig.]]
Zash's preparations on Dromund Kaas for the ritual were concluded at the time her apprentice concluded their business on Alderaan. Zash summoned them at once to meet her in the Dark Temple for the culmination of their joint ventures. But Kallig remembered their ancestor's words and took the Dashade, Khem Val, with them. It was in the Dark Temple that Zash revealed her true motives for the ritual as being her attempt to cheat death through possessing her student and transferring her consciousness into them. Their confrontation resulted in Zash gaining the upper hand and beginning the ritual; Val intervened and attacked Zash as she concentrated on the ritual knocking her backwards into the air.<ref name="TOR:Legacy" />

==Aftermath==
In the skirmish's aftermath Zash discovered that her consciousness had in fact been transferred into the Dashade as opposed to her apprentice. In a rage she threatened to use the creature's power to exact vengeance upon Kallig, though the apprentice reminded her that Val was [[Force-bond/Legends|bound]] to them and, by extension, Zash too. Corrin and Kaal walked in and saw their master's body lying on the floor. Presuming Kallig had slain Zash, they bowed down to the Inquisitor, who was granted the title of Lord Kallig.
